name: Jazz duo playing Blue Bossa on guitar and upright bass
seoTitle: Jazz duo: Blue Bossa on guitar and upright bass
description: Here's our jazz duo playing Blue Bossa on guitar and upright bass. It's a great pick if you like a little bossa nova with your jazz.
more: Blue Bossa is on our song list along with The Girl from Ipanema and Wave. With just two musicians, it's easy for us to keep the volume low, so your guests can talk without raising their voices.
